guard: A manager binds a host runtime result only when it is closed, echoes its own target, and carries no provider reference; the enrollment result's runtimeIntent is accepted only as { state: "reserved" } and an older host that omits it still binds
why: The provider-handle mutation opens the result binder to a providerHandle field. A host body could then hand the participant a provider reference as if it were part of the answer, which the contract forbids.
The target mutation stops comparing the echoed target, so a host answer for another agent would be read as this agent's state.
The runtimeIntent-shape mutation accepts any runtimeIntent, so a host could present a non-reserved state or a handle through the display-only field.
The older-host mutation requires runtimeIntent, which would break every manager talking to a host that predates the field.

mutations.name: runtime result binder accepts a provider handle
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: a host body carrying a provider handle is refused by the manager
mutations.cell: a host body carrying a provider handle is refused by the manager

mutations.name: runtime result binder ignores the echoed target
mutations.find:
r.requestId !== request.requestId || r.owner !== request.target.owner ||
      JSON.stringify(r.target) !== JSON.stringify(request.target))
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: a host body naming another target is refused by the manager
mutations.cell: a host body naming another target is refused by the manager

mutations.name: enrollment binder accepts any runtimeIntent
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: a runtimeIntent in another state is refused
mutations.cell: a runtimeIntent in another state is refused

mutations.name: enrollment binder requires runtimeIntent, refusing an older host
mutations.replace:
const { runtimeIntent, ...envelope } = (result ?? {}) as RemoteManagedAgentEnrollmentResult;
  if (runtimeIntent === undefined) throw new Error("managed agent enrollment returned a non-closed result");
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: an older host that omits runtimeIntent still enrolls
mutations.cell: an older host that omits runtimeIntent still enrolls
